scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @padaria/shared && npm run build --workspace @padaria/db && npm run build --workspace @padaria/api && npm run build --workspace @padaria/web-vue
scripts.check: npm run check:texto && npm run check:arquitetura && npm run check:migrations && npm run check --workspace @padaria/shared && npm run check --workspace @padaria/db && npm run check:scripts && npm run check --workspace @padaria/api && npm run check --workspace @padaria/web-vue && npm run check --workspace @padaria/tests
scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace @padaria/shared && npm run build --workspace @padaria/db
scripts.lint: npm run build:libs && eslint api db shared tests web-vue scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: npm run build:libs && eslint api db shared tests web-vue scripts eslint.config.mjs --fix
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run lint:deps && npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run audit:deps
scripts.test:complete: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run lint:deps && npm run check && npm run build && npm test && npm run audit:deps && npm run knip && npm run depcheck
scripts.dev:vue: cross-env PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100 NUXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100 npm run dev --workspace @padaria/web-vue -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174
scripts.db:dev:up: docker compose -p padaria-db-dev -f db/docker-compose-db.yml -f db/docker-compose-db.dev.yml up -d --wait
scripts.db:dev:down: docker compose -p padaria-db-dev -f db/docker-compose-db.yml -f db/docker-compose-db.dev.yml down
scripts.db:prod:up: docker compose -p padaria-prod-db -f db/docker-compose-db.yml -f db/docker-compose-db.prod.yml up -d --wait
scripts.db:prod:down: docker compose -p padaria-prod-db -f db/docker-compose-db.yml -f db/docker-compose-db.prod.yml down
scripts.compose:up: npm run db:dev:up && docker compose -p padaria-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build api
scripts.compose:coolify:check: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@db.example:5432/padaria BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=dummy-secret-with-at-least-32-chars AUTH_BASE_URL=https://api.example.test WEB_ORIGIN=https://app.example.test NUXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.example.test ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test ADMIN_SENHA=dummy-admin-pass docker compose -p padaria-coolify --project-directory . -f infra/docker-compose.coolify.yml config --quiet
